data.name: FullReconciliationPassNotice
data.value: This criterion compares an expression against a relative date. Temporal Scope Reconciliation can only narrow a relative date to the objects whose date crossed it when the date is stored in an attribute, so for this rule every reconciliation evaluates every object of its type, in batches. On a large object type, prefer flowing the date into an attribute and comparing that.
data.comment: The note shown when a Scoping Criterion needs a full Temporal Scope Reconciliation pass.
